body:
Create declarative subagent definitions (agent.json and config.yaml) under .agents/agents/ for booster specialist roles (prosecutor, spec-linter, fleet-scheduler) so Jetski IDE/CLI users can invoke them natively via invoke_subagent.

Acceptance criteria:
1. .agents/agents/ manifests conform to Jetski custom agent specification.
2. Standard booster specialist agents are registered and validated.
3. npm test passes cleanly.
title: feat: expose declarative subagent manifests under .agents/agents/
